assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the PR-204 denial
CPT 93229 is described as Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
The patient has a history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction
The submitted diagnosis codes are G45.9 and Z86.73
The patient is currently experiencing intermittent episodes of dizziness and palpitations
The dizziness and palpitations raise concern for an underlying arrhythmia
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during symptomatic events
The purpose is to evaluate for potential cardioembolic sources contributing to transient cerebral ischemic symptoms
The ordered service directly addresses the documented indication
